description: FK → Calendar Date Dimension. Date key: Decision Date (Nguồn C — examination team không có hành vi ACTIVE, lấy trực tiếp từ Examination Team)
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = examination_team.decision_dt AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' AND examination_team.decision_dt = :etl_date WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship INNER JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' AND violation_behavior.life_cycle_status_code = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN violation_record ON violation_record.violation_record_id = violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship.violation_record_id AND violation_record.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD' LEFT JOIN violation_case_received_document ON violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id = violation_record.violation_record_id LEFT JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = violation_case_received_document.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' WHERE violation_record.examination_team_id = examination_team.examination_team_id OR violation_case.examination_team_id = examination_team.examination_team_id)

description: FK → Examination Team Dimension — Nguồn C: lookup trực tiếp theo Examination Team Code (không qua Violation Record/Violation Case)
etl_logic: LOOKUP examination_team_dim ON examination_team_dim.examination_team_code = examination_team.examination_team_code WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship INNER JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' AND violation_behavior.life_cycle_status_code = 'ACTIVE' INNER JOIN violation_record ON violation_record.violation_record_id = violation_record_x_violation_behavior_relationship.violation_record_id AND violation_record.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD' LEFT JOIN violation_case_received_document ON violation_case_received_document.violation_record_id = violation_record.violation_record_id LEFT JOIN violation_case ON violation_case.violation_case_id = violation_case_received_document.violation_case_id AND violation_case.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_CASE' WHERE violation_record.examination_team_id = examination_team.examination_team_id OR violation_case.examination_team_id = examination_team.examination_team_id)
